methodologyNotes: Products selected from the high-search stand mixer roster in the brief. The Breville Bakery Boss BEM825BAL (1200 W) is an Australian/international variant not sold through standard US retail, so the verified US Breville model BEM800XL (Scraper Mixer Pro, 550 W) was substituted (noted in provenance). Data independently re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer pages (kitchenaid.com, hamiltonbeach.com, ankarsrum.com/us, cuisinart.com), major retail listings (Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Abt, Amazon, ATBBQ, King Arthur Baking, NutriMill) and reference manuals (ManualsLib/manua.ls). motor_watts = rated input watts as stated on product pages; weight_lb = net unit weight where derivable (retailer listings sometimes cite higher shipping weights); attachment_hub = true when the manufacturer's universal power hub is present for optional powered attachments; price reflects published US retail/MSRP as of access date. Two adversarial corrections were made: KitchenAid Artisan KSM150PS price was overstated as MSRP $499.95 and corrected to the canonical $449.99 MSRP; the KitchenAid Pro Line KSM7586P is discontinued/being replaced (by KSM70SKXX) with no reliable single published US price for the exact config, so its priceUsd was set to null. All accessedAt = 2026-06-15.
